trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِمَعَاقِدِ الْعِزِّ مِنْ عَرْشِكَ وَمُنْتَهَى الرَّحْمَةِ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ وَبِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّةِ الَّتِيْ لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ فَاِنَّكَ لَا تَبِيْدُ وَلَا تَنْفَدُ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَقَبَّلَ مِنِّيْ وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ صِيَامَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَقِيَامَهٗ وَتَفُكَّ رِقَابَنَا مِنَ النَّارِ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاجْعَلْ قَلْبِيْ بَارًّا وَعَمَلِي سَارًّا وَرِزْقِيْ دَارًّا وَحَوْضَ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ السَّلَامُ لِيْ قَرَارًا وَمُسْتَقَرًّا وَتُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ فِيْ عَافِيَةٍ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-MA-AA’QE-DIL I’ZZE MIN ARSHE-KA WA MUNTA-HAR RAH-MATE MIN KETAABE-KA WA BISME-KAL A’ZAME WA KALEMAA-TE-KAT TAMMA-TIL LATEE LAA YO-JAAWE-ZO HUNNA BARROON WA LAA FAAJE-ROON FA-INNA-KA LAA TABEE-DO WA LAA TAN-FADO AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA TA-QABBAL MINNEE WA MIN JAMEE-I’L MOMENEE-NA WAL MOMENAA-TE SEYAA-MA SHAHRE RAMAZAA-NA WA QEYAAMA-HU WA TA-FUKKA REQAA-BANAA MENAN NAARE. ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WAJ-A’L QALBEE BARRAN WA A’MALE SARRAN WA RIZQEE DAARAN WA HAWZA NABIYYE-KA A’LAIY-HE WA AALE-HIS SALAAMO LEE QARAA-RAN WA MUSTA-QARRAN WA TO-A’JJE-LA FARAJA AALE MOHAMMADIN FEE A’A-FEYA-TAN YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O my God! I ask You by the juncture of the Might of Your Throne and the ultimate Mercy from Your Book and by Your Grand Name and Your Perfect Words that no good or bad person can violate for indeed You do not get destroyed or end I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) and accept from me and from all the believing men and women the fasting and the waking up at nights during the month of Ramadhan and liberate our necks from the fire of Hell Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) Let me be good in heart, with effective deeds, an ample sustenance and let the Pond of your prophet (s.a.w.a) be my station & abode Please expedite the arrival of Muhammad’s Progeny with health O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
